crossRefs.note: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have…
For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which…
All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and…
He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”
translations.bsb: For Moses has been proclaimed in every city from ancient times and is read in the synagogues on every Sabbath.”
translations.kjv: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
translations.asv: For Moses from generations of old hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath.
